notes.description: Requirement 1 (ChannelMessagesController permit): Diff line 58 changes `.permit(:body)` to `.permit(:body, :subject)`. Correct.

Requirement 3 (BulkChannelMessagesController permit): Diff line 18 changes `.permit(:body, :hiring_stage_id, ...)` to `.permit(:body, :subject, :hiring_stage_id, ...)`. Correct.

Requirement 4 (BulkChannelMessagesController sanitize): Diff line 20 adds `next_params[:subject] = sanitize(next_params[:subject]) if next_params.key?(:subject)` — identical guard pattern to the existing body sanitization at line 19. Correct.

Requirement 5 (BulkChannelMessagesController hand-built hash): Diff line 9 adds `subject: bulk_channel_message_params[:subject]` in the hand-built literal hash alongside `body: bulk_channel_message_params[:body]`. This is the critical spec requirement that prevents subject from silently dropping. Correctly implemented.

Requirement 6 (ChannelMessageTemplatesController permit): Diff line 46 changes `.permit(:name, :body, :position)` to `.permit(:name, :body, :subject, :position)`. No sanitization added — consistent with existing behavior (this controller does not include Sanitizer and does not sanitize body). Correct.
Requirement 7 (JobsController permit): Diff line 76 adds `:apply_response_template_subject` to the permitted params list, placed immediately after the existing `:apply_response_template`. Correct.

Requirement 8 (JobsController sanitize): Diff lines 84-86 add a new `if sanitized_params.key?(:apply_response_template_subject)` block with `sanitize()` call, following the exact same guard pattern as the existing `apply_response_template` sanitization at lines 268-272. Correct.

Requirement 9 (HiringStageMessageAutomationsController no-permit): Confirmed the diff does not touch `hiring_stage_message_automations_controller.rb`. Verified the source file's existing permit list is `(:channel_message_template_id, :hiring_stage_id, :frequency, :enabled)` — no subject. Correct.

Requirement 10 (CandidatesController anonymization): Diff lines 32-33 add `channel_message.subject = text_replacer(channel_message.subject, real_first_name, name_replacement)` and the matching `real_last_name` call. Placement is after the existing body_sanitized_html calls and before `channel_message.save!`. The `text_replacer` method (line 225 of source) handles nil/blank gracefully (`return text if text.blank?`), so historical messages with NULL subject will not raise. Correct.

Diff line 307 (ChannelMessageTemplateSelectionModal.tsx) has `font-size: ${t.text.sm};` which matches the Known Failure Pattern #1 documented in the pipeline CLAUDE.md — t.text.sm is a complete CSS declaration including `font-size:`, so this produces invalid CSS (`font-size: font-size: 0.875rem;`). This file is outside my focus area (frontend, not controllers) but is worth flagging for the frontend reviewer.
